2025-01-01, Aiya, 29, Accountant, What is your most frequent activity in the mobile banking app?, The AI assistant gives irrelevant responses., Bill payment failure, usability:complex-navigation
2025-01-04, Brandon, 34, Software Engineer, What is your most frequent activity in the mobile banking app?, The app freezing during transfers is really annoying., User confused by navigation, notifications:delayed

2025-01-10, Dimas, 31, Project Manager, What is your most frequent activity in the mobile banking app?, The saved accounts load too slowly., User reports slow performance, performance:slow-loading
2025-01-13, Elena, 26, Graphic Designer, How often do you make transfers per week?, The app freezing during transfers is really annoying., Feature request: quick transfer, bill-payment:save-failure
2025-01-16, Farhan, 30, Data Analyst, Can you describe a recent negative experience using the app?, User confused by navigation, performance:slow-loading

2025-02-12, Oscar, 38, HR Manager, Which feature do you wish worked better?, Around 46 transfers per week., Auto-logout issue, reliability:auto-logout

By topics
Performance and technical issues
App performance issues, particularly during transfers, emerge as a major pain point with multiple users reporting app freezing and slow loading times.
Slow loading of saved accounts and general performance issues impact core functionalities.
Navigation and AI assistance
Users express frustration with complex navigation and irrelevant AI assistant responses.
Navigation confusion appears as a recurring theme across different user roles.
Account management and authentication
Users report disruptive auto-logout issues during important transactions.
Money transfers and balance checking are identified as primary activities, but technical issues hinder smooth execution.
